gold.question: What annual statutory interest rate must a trader add when reimbursing a consumer under Article 13 of Directive 2011/83/EU?
gold.unanswerable_reason: Article 13 of Directive 2011/83/EU requires reimbursement of the payments it identifies and, in a later paragraph, use of the same means of payment without fees, but it states no interest rate. The other directives state reimbursement periods or prohibit fees on reimbursement, and the Annex to Directive 93/13/EEC discusses contract terms about interest charged for financial services. None of those provisions sets a statutory annual rate on an Article 13 reimbursement.
gold.refusal_reference: The frozen five-document corpus does not contain sufficient information to answer this question.
